verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes an official GitHub repo (snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs) with OpenAPI-compliant specifications and importable Postman collections, and its REST API docs explicitly reference building integrations from these OpenAPI specs. The probe 404s only show the spec is not hosted at conventional docs-site paths. That limits discoverability but does not contradict the spec's availability. Missing for 10: spec served at a discoverable well-known/docs URL, evidence that the SQL API is also covered by a machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration of using the specs.
